data.description: Vacant Contemporary Villa in Internal Location
data.display_address: District One Villas, District One, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Exclusive contemporary standalone villa located in a prime internal position, offering privacy, space, and premium community living.

Unit Details:

• Standalone Villa
• Contemporary Style – Type A
• Internal Location
• Vacant
• 4 Bedrooms
• 5 Bathrooms
• Community View
• Open & Fully Fitted Kitchen
• 2 Parking Spaces
• Built-up Area: 6,393 sq ft
• Plot Size: 8,290 sq ft
• Unfurnished
• Price: AED 22,000,000

This beautifully designed villa features a spacious open-plan layout with modern architecture and abundant natural light. The living and dining areas flow seamlessly, creating an ideal space for family living and entertaining.
All bedrooms are well-proportioned, with built-in wardrobes and ensuite bathrooms. The property also includes a maid’s room and separate driver’s room for added convenience.

Key Features:

• Private swimming pool
• Spacious balconies
• Built-in wardrobes
• Central A/C
• Covered parking
• Pet-friendly community
• Security services
• Close to lagoon and community amenities

Situated in a peaceful and highly sought-after community, this villa offers easy access to the lagoon, parks, and walking areas, while maintaining excellent privacy and exclusivity.
